sql.overridePlan.create: INSERT INTO brs.override_plan (name, description, position_id, total, created_by, created, updated_by, updated) VALUES (:name, :description, :positionId, :total, :createdBy, now(), :createdBy, now()) RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.update: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET name = :name, description = :description, position_id = :positionId, total = :total, updated_by = :updatedBy, updated = now() WHERE id = :id RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.clone: SELECT clone_override_plan AS id FROM brs.clone_override_plan( :planId::int, :startDate:: DATE, :assignedUsers::int[], :receivingUsers::int[], :createdBy::int, :userId::int)
sql.overridePlan.getPlanStatus: SELECT status_type FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id
sql.overridePlan.getReceivingUser:
SELECT row_to_json(receiving) receiving FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, opu.m1_allocation AS "m1Allocation", opu.m2_allocation AS "m2Allocation", (select string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') from flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.user_id = u.id
) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id WHERE override_plan_id = :planId and u.id = :userId) receiving;
sql.overridePlan.addReceivingUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_receiving_user (override_plan_id, user_id, m1_allocation, m2_allocation) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :m1Allocation, :m2Allocation) ON CONFLICT (override_plan_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET m1_allocation = EXCLUDED.m1_allocation, m2_allocation = EXCLUDED.m2_allocation RETURNING override_plan_id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.updateReceivingUser: UPDATE brs.override_plan_receiving_user SET note = :note, m1_allocation = :m1, m2_allocation = :m2 WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.deleteReceivingUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.setEndDateAssignedUser: WITH active_user_plans AS (SELECT opau.id, op.id AS plan_id, op.name AS plan_name, ops.status_type, opau.user_id, opau.start_date, opau.end_date FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL AND opau.start_date <= :startDate) UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user u SET end_date = :startDate :: DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM active_user_plans p where u.id = p.id
sql.overridePlan.insertAssignedUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_assigned_user (override_plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :startDate, :endDate) RETURNING override_plan_id ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.updateAssignedUser: WITH update_assigned_user AS (UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.deleteAssignedUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.approve: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET approved = now(), approved_by = :approvedBy, updated = now(), updated_by = :approvedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.inactivate: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.findById:
SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, op.description, op.total, ops.status_type AS status, op.position_id AS "positionId", (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.created_by) u) AS "createdBy", op.created, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.updated_by) u) AS "updatedBy", op.updated, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name FROM flow."user" u WHERE u.id = op.approved_by) u) AS "approvedBy", op.approved, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, opu.m1_allocation AS "m1Allocation", opu.m2_allocation AS "m2Allocation", (select string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') from flow.user_position up inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.user_id = u.id
) AS position, (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id in (9902,9400,3287,3286,3285,3284,3283,3282,3281,3280,3279,3278,3277,3276,3275,454,404) and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = opu.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id WHERE override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u), '[]') AS "receivingUsers", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate", (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id in (9902,9400,3287,3286,3285,3284,3283,3282,3281,3280,3279,3278,3277,3276,3275,454,404) and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = opa.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u), '[]') AS "assignedUsers" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id) t;
sql.overridePlan.findUserHistory: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))), '[]') FROM ( SELECT opau.id, op.id AS "planId", op.name AS "planName", ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId ORDER BY opau.end_date DESC ) aup
sql.overridePlan.findUsers:
SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))), '[]') FROM (SELECT u.id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, u.email, (SELECT string_agg( distinct position, ', ') FROM flow.user_position up1 INNER JOIN flow.position p1 ON p1.id = up1.position_id WHERE up1.user_id = u.id AND CASE WHEN :positionId = 1 THEN array[p1.id] = any (select cf.system_list_option_ids from flow.custom_field cf where cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 and cf.company_id = 3) WHEN :positionId = 4 THEN p1.id IN (4, 5, 6) END) AS position, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = u.id WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL OR opau.end_date >= current_date) aup), '[]') AS "assignedUserPlans" FROM flow."user" u WHERE ( concat(lower(trim(first_name)), ' ', lower(trim(last_name))) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(trim(last_name)) LIKE lower(:search) OR lower(trim(u.email)) LIKE lower(:search) ) AND (CASE WHEN :positionId:: INT IS NOT NULL THEN u.id IN (SELECT up.user_id FROM flow.user_position up INNER JOIN flow.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN :positionId = 1 THEN array[p.id] = any (select unnest(cf.system_list_option_ids) from flow.custom_field cf where cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 and cf.company_id = 3) WHEN :positionId = 4 THEN p.id IN (4, 5, 6) END)) ELSE 1 = 1 END) and ( case when :planId::int is not null and :isReceiving::boolean is true then u.id not in ( select user_id from brs.override_plan_receiving_user where override_plan_id = :planId ) else 1 = 1 end ) and ( case when :planId::int is not null and :isReceiving::boolean is false then u.id not in ( select user_id from brs.override_plan_assigned_user where override_plan_id = :planId ) else 1 = 1 end )
ORDER BY first_name, last_name LIMIT 10) results;
sql.overridePlan.updatePlanUser: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = :note, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.getAssignedUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate", (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id in (9902,9400,3287,3286,3285,3284,3283,3282,3281,3280,3279,3278,3277,3276,3275,454,404) and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = opa.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = :planId GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u
sql.overridePlan.getAssignedUser: SELECT row_to_json(assigned) assigned FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, p.position, p.id AS "positionId", opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = :planId and u.id = :userId AND up.archived IS NOT TRUE AND up.primary_flag IS TRUE) assigned;
sql.overridePlan.getReceivingUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", opu.allocation, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS name, up.active, string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER ( WHERE CASE WHEN op.position_id = 1 THEN up.id IN (select up5.id from flow.user_position up5 inner join flow.custom_field cf on up5.position_id = any(cf.system_list_option_ids) and cf.parent_custom_field_id = 9959 where up5.primary_flag is true and up5.archived is false and cf.archived is false) WHEN op.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position, (select cfv.text_value from flow.user_custom_field_value cfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id where cfga.custom_field_id in (9902,9400,3287,3286,3285,3284,3283,3282,3281,3280,3279,3278,3277,3276,3275,454,404) and cfga.archived is false and cfv.user_id = opu.user_id ) as "employeeId" FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opu.override_plan_id = op.id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN flow.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE op.id = :planId AND up.active IS TRUE GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u;
